kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd nilpotent central element of the inhomogeneous extension

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity element; identified with scalar 1, excluded from basis

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [odd: E_eps1_del{k}_pp,pm,mp,mm] < [even: H, E_2del_p, E_del_del_pp, E_2del_m, E_del_del_mm, E_del_del_pm, E_del_del_mp]  (K = 1 excluded)

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y); gamma linear in gb. Z='K' denotes the central constant (kappa*K = kappa).
inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_parity_rule: p(Z) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 (mod 2); Z='K' has parity 0
